label: settlement_legacy
notes: Older settlement contract, verified on Celo Blockscout as AggregateBridge. Confirmed GP-owned by Gnosis Pay 2026-08-05; still settling daily and scheduled for migration onto settlement_current at an unannounced date. Provisioned 235 cards 2026-03-31..2026-06-11. Declares 6 events, of which 5 have fired. Shares ZERO event signatures with settlement_current, so it needs its own ABI - but the ABIs (fetched 2026-08-06) show WHY, and it is not that these are unrelated systems: both are named AggregateBridge and expose identical function selectors (settle, USDC, USDT, USDT_OFT, quoteNativeBridgeFee), and every settlement_current event simply adds an indexed `sender` as its first parameter, which changes the signature and therefore the topic0. Two generations of one design. Per-payment event is TokenPullSuccess ccc11cdc.
